reference.title: Fix capture-prior silently dropping tool calls
reference.summary: Root-caused a P1 data-loss bug where capture-prior — the path that reconstructs a session from a prior Claude Code conversation — was dropping every tool call and the bulk of assistant responses, leaving ledger entries without the most valuable content (file reads/writes, implementations, error recovery). The implementation iterated through three architectural designs driven by user feedback, landing on capture-prior as a proper adapter-protocol method (like import-session) so each coding-agent adapter owns its own session parsing. The session ended mid-implementation of that final redesign with 12,326 tests passing and zero lint issues, but the work isn't merged.
key_actions: Diagnosed capture-prior as silently dropping tool calls and full assistant responses
Designed iteration 1: in-place fix inside capture-prior
Redesigned after user feedback: route through the adapter layer
Final design: capture-prior becomes an adapter-protocol method alongside import-session
Began implementing adapter-owned capture-prior in ox-adapter-claude
Held 12,326 tests green and 0 lint issues through the WIP
